title: PollutedLands
description: PollutedLands adds a dynamic pollution system where over-mining and exploitation in a chunk leads to environmental decay, corrupted mobs, and eerie visual effects, creating a harsher, more immersive survival experience.
body: **PollutedLands** adds an immersive environmental decay system to Minecraft 1.21.4. As players overuse land—mining, deforesting, or farming mobs—chunks become polluted, triggering visual degradation, hostile mob changes, and reduced natural life. To restore balance, players must purify the land through replanting, rituals, or specialized tools, turning sustainability into survival.
